findings.claim: Concurrent reservations can both succeed against the same stock, allowing the service to accept more reservations than inventory can fulfill.
evidence: evals/cases/case_04/src/inventory.py:9-15 performs an unsynchronized read-check-sleep-write sequence, so concurrent calls can validate and update from the same stale stock value.

A targeted ThreadPoolExecutor probe ran two concurrent reserve('sku-1', 1) calls against one available unit; in all five attempts both calls returned true while available('sku-1') ended at 0, confirming that two reservations were accepted from one unit.
evals/cases/case_04/tests/test_inventory.py:4-8 covers only a single reservation and does not exercise concurrent access.
